reason: The design uses existing repository, execution fleet, CI, Vercel and Postgres capabilities; public GitHub activity and checked-in job data require no new credential. No new KV, paid API, or account is needed.

prerequisites.required_setup: GitHub repository quiinthieu/otohime is readable and the registered SSH origin permits main push under existing repository/account authority and cost arrangement; no new credential requested. Control-plane read does not prove checkout push.

Existing task-manager otohime software_engineer account and execution runner provide Node 22, locked npm install, Chrome/browser, npm network and registered Git SSH; scheduler owns placement under existing cost authority.

GitHub Actions on quiinthieu/otohime can run current checks and deploy workflow on main using hosted runners, Node 22, repository read token and existing GitHub Actions configuration under existing account/cost authority.

probe.expect: CI workflow enabled with runnable checks and production jobs

prerequisites.required_setup: Existing Vercel project for otohime.dev under the current account/cost authority has its GitHub Actions deployment configured with repository-managed VERCEL_TOKEN deploy permission and VERCEL_ORG_ID/VERCEL_PROJECT_ID project placement. No new project or credential requested; site reachability is only a control-plane probe.

probe.expect: HTTP 200 with full sha from production

prerequisites.required_setup: Existing Neon Postgres project for otohime.dev permits the GitHub Actions deployment job to create a migration branch, run Drizzle migrations using DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED, and supply pooled DATABASE_URL to Vercel under current database/project cost authority. Migration job must independently prove runner secrets and DDL permission.

probe.expect: HTTP 200 from app backed by existing Postgres deployment
